claim_boundary: This graph organises and reconstructs established prerequisites. It does not assert new RH mathematics.

nodes.label: Dirichlet-series identity and summation for Re(s) > 1
Analyticity away from the pole at one
Completed and ordinary zeta functional equations
Trivial zeros at negative even integers
Closedness, discreteness, and compact finiteness of the zero set
Every zero with Re(s) <= 0 is a negative-even trivial zero
Reflection and conjugation symmetry orbit of non-trivial zeros
Every non-trivial zero has real part one half

selected_target.precise_blocker: All classical location and symmetry prerequisites in this graph are reconstructed. The remaining target is the open assertion that every nontrivial zero has real part one half; progress now requires a genuinely stronger analytic or arithmetic inequality, not additional rearrangement of the functional equation.
selected_target.success_authority: Lean kernel through the pinned Mathlib dependency

next_target.next_subtarget: Select and formalize a non-circular equivalent criterion capable of constraining zeros inside the open critical strip.
next_target.preferred_route: Chebyshev psi error-bound criterion, because pinned Mathlib already contains psi, von Mangoldt identities, and the zeta logarithmic derivative on Re(s) > 1.
next_target.missing_bridge: An explicit-formula framework relating the Chebyshev psi remainder to nontrivial zeta zeros; Mathlib has no existing RH equivalence theorem for this route.
